Package Overview

This is the boilerplate R package - a tool for managing and generating standardized text for methods and results sections of scientific reports. It uses a unified database system with template variable substitution.

Development Commands

Build and Check

# Build documentation
devtools::document()

# Run R CMD check
devtools::check()

# Build package
devtools::build()

# Install locally
devtools::install()

Testing

# Run all tests
devtools::test()

# Run specific test file
testthat::test_file("tests/units-test.R")

Documentation

# Build pkgdown site
pkgdown::build_site()

# Update README from README.Rmd
devtools::build_readme()

Architecture

Unified Database System

The package uses a unified database approach where all content types (methods, results, discussion, measures, appendices, templates) are managed through a single consistent interface:

  • boilerplate_init() - Initialise all databases
  • boilerplate_import() - Import databases into unified structure
  • boilerplate_save() - Save unified database or specific categories
  • Category accessors: boilerplate_methods(), boilerplate_measures(), etc.

Hierarchical Path System

Content is organized using dot notation paths (e.g., methods.statistical.longitudinal.lmtp). This allows: - Nested organization of content - Wildcard operations on paths - Batch editing capabilities

Template System

Uses {{variable}} placeholders for dynamic content substitution: - Global variables available to all sections - Section-specific variables for fine control - Text overrides for customization

Key Functions by Purpose

Database Management: - init-functions.R - Database initialization - import-export-functions.R - I/O operations - merge-databases.R - Database merging operations

Text Generation: - generate-text.R - Core text generation engine - generate-measures.R - Measure-specific generation

Batch Operations: - boilerplate_batch_edit_functions.R - Batch editing - boilerplate_standardise_measures.R - Standardization

Utilities: - path-operations.R - Path manipulation - category-helpers.R - Category extraction - utilities.R - General helpers

Important Notes

  • The package requires R >= 4.1
  • Uses roxygen2 for documentation generation
  • Follows tidyverse style conventions
  • All user-facing functions include confirmation prompts for safety
  • File naming follows standardized patterns to prevent overwrites
  • The package website is at https://go-bayes.github.io/boilerplate/
